Commentary.Commentary: Virat Kohli is handed over the trophy. Just what he mentioned in his interview, he loved Saha's approach and he hands it over to the Indian keeper and then the rest of his teammates join to pose for the cameras. Lovely scenes! That's it from us then! We hope for your company on 27th August for the first T20I to be played in Florida between these two sides. Until next time, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Indian skipper, VIRAT KOHLI says he killed time by playing playstation and hit the gym for the last 4 days. Is disappointed as they used to get up every morning but didn't get to play. On not being the No. 1 Test team anymore, he replies that he has said it before that it's just an incentive and this will just keep tumbling and they have a chance to regain it. Accepts it was a collective effort from his team but gives a special mention to Saha for putting his hand up and considers it as one of the biggest positives. Adds everyone in the team is of the same age group and that allows them to come and share whatever they want with him. On new coach, he says Kumble's passion for cricket is just next level and he expects us to be on top in every session. On New Zealand's tour to India, Kohli says he is ready for it and admits that his team has to be on toes as they will be meeting some quality sides in the coming months.

Man of the Series, RAVICHANDRAN ASHWIN says this is his 6th Man of the Series award and he's aware of that but not doesn't know that out of the seven series win since his debut, he has won six of them. Mentions his team played some good cricket and they have a good team atmosphere. Says they decided they will try with the 5-bowler strategy in all the games. Adds everyone is aware of their role and they contribute wherever they can.

West Indian skipper, JASON HOLDER accepts it was a hard fought series for him and his team. Says there is some positives to take as they have some 5-wicket hauls and tons to take from this series. Adds they falter when it comes to this format but will try to do well in future. Credits team India for coming here and playing with them. Hopes they can do well in the Middle East when they tour there next. Ends by saying, going forward they need to seize certain moments and take control of Tests.
Time for Presentation...

Here we go! The match officials have decided to CALL OFF THE MATCH after having a talk with both the skippers. The weather was bright and sunny but the outfield has received a terrible beating due to which the verdict has been given. Fans in Pakistan can start to celebrate as their team is now the No. 1 Test team in the world. India take the series 2-0 and now these two will take the action to Florida for 2 T20Is starting from 27th August, 2016 at 1000 local time. We are hearing that the presentation will be held at 1130 local time. Let's see what the captains have to say.

PLAY HAS BEEN CALLED OFF due to persistent and heavy rain. It looked a bit promising just after Lunch when the sun broke out and the rain stopped but it again started pouring after a while. The match is halted because of rains and we hope that we get to see more cricketing action our way. Stay tuned for more updates...

The players and umpires are out in the middle. KRAIGG BRATHWAITE and LEON JOHNSON are at the crease. The former taking the strike. BHUVNESHWAR KUMAR to bowl first up. Here we go..

Indian skipper Virat Kohli says No. 1 Test ranking is a very good incentive for the way they have played Test Cricket. Adds that they are happy to bowl first as the pitch was under covers and reckons that there would be some moisture in the pitch. Adds that it is very difficult to get momentum as a team and it is good that they have gained momentum and would like to continue with it. Mentions there are two changes in the team. Murali Vijay comes in for Shikhar Dhawan and India are playing an extra batsman in the form of Cheteshwar Pujara so Ravindra Jadeja misses out.

West Indies captain Jason Holder wins the toss. Says they are going to bat first. Adds that as the game progresses, the pitch tends to break up. Adds there will be some moisture in the pitch in the first hour but they are confident that their batsmen will apply themselves well. Admits that there is still something left to play and to salvage some pride. Mentions there is one change in the team. Devendra Bishoo comes in place of Alzarri Joseph.
TOSS - West Indies win the toss and elect to bat first!

Pitch report - Jeffrey Dujon reckons that the pitch has been covered because of the rains. The pitch has some stickiness and will be a difficult time for the batsmen battling out there. Spin bowling will be a bit slow and should provide some turn early on. With the moisture been on, the team winning the toss will look to bowl first.

Winning was always a longshot for the Caribbean hosts but they fought hard along the way, managing to draw the 2nd Test. Their understrength side has relied upon their more experienced players and had a degree of success but it has not been enough to make a mark. They are a passionate side and with a cleansheet looming, will be looking to put up a fight.

India have occasionally been in sticky situations but the trusty Ravichandran Ashwin has allowed them to pull through. Along the way, the strength of the visitors side has seen their players step and fill any gaps they might have had.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 4th and final Test of the series between West Indies and India. We have seen the tourists play a versatile brand of cricket under their captain, Virat Kohli, that has given them a 2-0 lead to clinch the series. For them, it is now going to be a battle to remain on top of the ICC Test rankings.
